headword: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}

definitions.gloss: driving under the influence of alcohol; DUI
definitions.explanation: Driving while having alcohol in one's system, even if not severely intoxicated. Under Japanese law, drivers with blood alcohol above a certain threshold but below the drunk driving limit are guilty of this offense. A lesser offense than 飲酒運転 (drunk driving) but still illegal.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}で{摘発|てきはつ}された。
examples.english: He was caught driving under the influence.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでもお{酒|さけ}を{飲|の}んだら{酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}になる{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: Even drinking a small amount of alcohol can result in driving under the influence.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}は{免許停止|めんきょていし}や{罰金|ばっきん}の{対象|たいしょう}になる{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Driving under the influence is a violation subject to license suspension and fines.

notes:
A legal traffic offense distinct from {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん} (drunk driving). {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん} refers specifically to driving with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15mg/L or above (but below the 0.25mg/L threshold for the more serious charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}で{捕|つか}まる: to be arrested for DUI
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}の{疑|うたが}い: suspicion of DUI

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}: drunk driving — the more serious offense involving higher blood alcohol levels
